rules.description: Forms that accept raw user input without visible sanitization hints. Dynamic SQL hints in error messages or comments. Server-side template injection hints (e.g., {{7*7}} in field names).
DOM-based XSS hints: Usage of document.write, innerHTML, or eval() in inline scripts without escaping.

rules.category: A08:2021 – Software and Data Integrity Failures
rules.description: Script/link tags loading external resources from CDNs without integrity (SRI) attributes. External scripts loaded over HTTP instead of HTTPS.
HTTP links used instead of HTTPS for sensitive routes. Sensitive data or tokens present in URL parameters. Autocomplete not disabled on sensitive fields (password, credit card).
Admin or debug routes exposed in source (e.g., /admin, /debug). Hidden form fields that control access (role=admin, isAdmin=true). Directory listing hints.
Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) meta tag. X-Frame-Options missing (clickjacking risk). Verbose error messages in comments or HTML. Framework/version disclosure in meta generators or comments.
Login forms missing rate-limiting hints (no CAPTCHA). Password fields that are not type="password". Session tokens visible in local storage access scripts.
URL input fields that accept full external URLs (e.g., image URL, webhook URL) without validation hints.
API keys, AWS tokens, JWTs, or other secrets hardcoded in JavaScript or meta tags. PII exposure (email addresses, SSNs in plain HTML).
